nl: 找出所有变道的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name, json_extract(param, '$.sub_tag') AS sub_tag FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name IN ('LaneChange') ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出切入事件的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name, json_extract(param, '$.sub_tag') AS sub_tag FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'Cutin' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出急刹车的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name, json_extract(param, '$.sub_tag') AS sub_tag FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 变道时周围有什么动态目标
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.obj_id, d.type, d.x, d.y FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'LaneChange' AND d.is_static = 0 ORDER BY r.start_ts, d.ts

nl: 急刹时自车速度是多少
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(r.param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 找出路口直行的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_STRAIGHT' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出闯红灯的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'RunRedLight' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出检测到行人的片段
sql: SELECT ts, obj_id, x, y, type FROM dynamic_obj WHERE type = 'pedestrian' AND is_static = 0 ORDER BY ts

nl: 找出速度超过120的片段
sql: SELECT ts, speed FROM ego WHERE speed > 120 ORDER BY ts

nl: 统计各种标签出现的次数
sql: SELECT tag_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM range_tag GROUP BY tag_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

nl: 找出实线变道的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'SolidLaneChange' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出跟车太近的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'CloseFollow' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 切入时自车的速度变化
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Cutin' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 找出有行人横穿的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'CrossVRUV1' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出路口右转的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_RIGHTTURN' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出自车速度为0的时段
sql: SELECT ts, speed FROM ego WHERE speed = 0 ORDER BY ts

nl: 变道时自车速度和方向盘转角
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, e.steering_angle FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'LaneChange' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 统计变道各子标签的数量
sql: SELECT json_extract(param, '$.sub_tag') AS sub_tag, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'LaneChange' GROUP BY json_extract(param, '$.sub_tag') ORDER BY cnt DESC

nl: 找出前方有静止障碍物的时刻
sql: SELECT ts, obj_id, x, y, type FROM dynamic_obj WHERE is_static = 1 AND x > 0 AND x < 100 ORDER BY ts

nl: 找出借道避让的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'AvoidanceBorrowLane' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出同时有切入和急刹的片段
sql: SELECT a.start_ts, a.end_ts FROM range_tag a JOIN range_tag b ON a.start_ts = b.start_ts AND a.end_ts = b.end_ts WHERE a.tag_name = 'Cutin' AND b.tag_name = 'Jerk' ORDER BY a.start_ts

nl: 找出切入或加塞的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name IN ('Cutin', 'SolidLaneChange') ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出路口左转的片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_LEFTTURN' ORDER BY start_ts

nl: 找出路口左转的片段并查看路口车道信息
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, i.intersection_id, i.lane_count, i.ego_lane_index, i.lane_info FROM range_tag r JOIN intersection_info i ON i.intersection_id = json_extract(r.param, '$.intersection_id') WHERE r.tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_LEFTTURN' ORDER BY r.start_ts

nl: 路口左转时自车的速度和方向盘转角
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, e.steering_angle FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_LEFTTURN' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 切入时切入车辆的详细信息
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.type, d.x, d.y, d.heading, d.absolute_velocity_x, d.relative_velocity_x FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Cutin' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 AND d.x < 50 ORDER BY r.start_ts, d.ts

nl: 跟车太近时前车的速度和距离
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.type, d.absolute_velocity_x FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'CloseFollow' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 AND d.x < 30 ORDER BY r.start_ts, d.ts

nl: 行人横穿时行人的位置和速度
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.type, d.absolute_velocity_x, d.absolute_velocity_y FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'CrossVRUV1' AND d.type = 'pedestrian' ORDER BY r.start_ts, d.ts

nl: 闯红灯时红绿灯状态
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.traffic_light_status, e.speed FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'RunRedLight' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 找出速度先快后慢的急减速片段
sql: WITH speed_changes AS (SELECT ts, speed, LAG(speed) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_speed FROM ego WHERE speed > 0) SELECT ts, speed, prev_speed, prev_speed - speed AS decel FROM speed_changes WHERE prev_speed - speed > 10 ORDER BY ts

nl: 找出方向盘急转的时刻
sql: WITH steer_changes AS (SELECT ts, steering_angle, LAG(steering_angle) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_angle FROM ego) SELECT ts, steering_angle, prev_angle, steering_angle - prev_angle AS delta_angle FROM steer_changes WHERE ABS(steering_angle - prev_angle) > 30 ORDER BY ts

nl: 找出每个动态目标最近的时刻
sql: SELECT obj_id, type, MAX(ts) AS last_seen FROM dynamic_obj WHERE is_static = 0 GROUP BY obj_id, type ORDER BY last_seen DESC

nl: 找出距离自车最近的前车
sql: SELECT ts, obj_id, x, y, type, absolute_velocity_x FROM dynamic_obj WHERE is_static = 0 AND type IN ('car','truck','bus','unknown_vehicle') AND x > 0 ORDER BY ts, x ASC

nl: 统计每个目标的类型分布
sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dynamic_obj WHERE is_static = 0 GROUP BY type ORDER BY cnt DESC

nl: 变道时自车与车道边界的距离
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.ego_to_left_boundary_dist, e.ego_to_right_boundary_dist, e.speed FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'LaneChange' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 借道避让时自车与车道边界距离和方向盘转角
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.ego_to_left_boundary_dist, e.ego_to_right_boundary_dist, e.steering_angle, e.speed FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'AvoidanceBorrowLane' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 急刹时前方有什么障碍物
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.type, d.x, d.y FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(r.param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 ORDER BY r.start_ts, d.ts

nl: 找出自车加速度最大的时刻
sql: SELECT ts, speed, acc_magnitude FROM ego WHERE acc_magnitude > 3 ORDER BY acc_magnitude DESC

nl: 找出红绿灯状态变化的时刻
sql: WITH light_changes AS (SELECT ts, traffic_light_status, LAG(traffic_light_status) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_status FROM ego WHERE traffic_light_status != 0) SELECT ts, traffic_light_status, prev_status FROM light_changes WHERE traffic_light_status != prev_status ORDER BY ts

nl: 统计每个bag中各种标签的数量
sql: SELECT tag_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM range_tag GROUP BY tag_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

nl: 找出持续超过10秒的场景片段
sql: SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name, (end_ts - start_ts) AS duration_sec FROM range_tag WHERE (end_ts - start_ts) > 10 ORDER BY duration_sec DESC

nl: 找出每种标签的平均持续时间
sql: SELECT tag_name, AVG(end_ts - start_ts) AS avg_duration_sec, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM range_tag GROUP BY tag_name ORDER BY avg_duration_sec DESC

nl: 路口左转时对向来车的位置和速度
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.heading, d.absolute_velocity_x FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_LEFTTURN' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 AND COS(RADIANS(d.heading)) < -0.5 ORDER BY r.start_ts, d.ts

nl: 找出变道和急刹同时发生的危险片段
sql: SELECT a.start_ts, a.end_ts, a.tag_name AS tag1, b.tag_name AS tag2 FROM range_tag a JOIN range_tag b ON a.start_ts = b.start_ts AND a.end_ts = b.end_ts WHERE a.tag_name = 'LaneChange' AND b.tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(b.param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake' ORDER BY a.start_ts

nl: 找出跟车太近且前车急刹的片段
sql: SELECT a.start_ts, a.end_ts FROM range_tag a JOIN range_tag b ON a.start_ts <= b.end_ts AND a.end_ts >= b.start_ts WHERE a.tag_name = 'CloseFollow' AND b.tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(b.param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake' ORDER BY a.start_ts

nl: 路口直行时自车速度和前方目标
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, d.obj_id, d.x, d.type FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 LEFT JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 WHERE r.tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_STRAIGHT' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 找出被超车的车辆的轨迹变化
sql: SELECT d.ts, d.obj_id, d.type, d.x, d.y, d.absolute_velocity_x, d.relative_velocity_x FROM dynamic_obj d WHERE d.is_static = 0 AND d.type IN ('car','truck','bus') AND d.x < 0 AND d.relative_velocity_x > 5 ORDER BY d.ts

nl: 车道内避让时障碍物的详细信息
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.type, d.x, d.y, d.heading FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Avoidance_InLane' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 ORDER BY r.start_ts, d.ts

nl: 雨天行驶时雨刮状态和自车速度
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.wiper_status, e.speed FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'RainLevel' ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: 匝道行驶时自车速度和加速度
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, e.acc_magnitude, e.steering_angle FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name IN ('OnRamp', 'OffRamp') ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: CTE: 找出切入车辆并计算其与自车的相对速度变化
sql: WITH cutin_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.relative_velocity_x, d.type FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Cutin' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0), with_lag AS (SELECT *, LAG(relative_velocity_x) OVER (PARTITION BY obj_id ORDER BY ts) AS prev_rv FROM cutin_frames) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, ts, obj_id, x, relative_velocity_x, prev_rv, relative_velocity_x - prev_rv AS rv_change FROM with_lag WHERE prev_rv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: CTE: 急刹时自车速度的逐帧变化并标注是否完全停止
sql: WITH brake_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, e.acc_magnitude FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(r.param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake') SELECT *, CASE WHEN speed < 1 THEN 'STOPPED' ELSE 'MOVING' END AS motion_state FROM brake_frames ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: CTE: 找出路口左转时距离最近的对向来车及其最小距离
sql: WITH left_turn_objs AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.heading, d.absolute_velocity_x FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_LEFTTURN' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0), per_obj AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, MIN(x) AS min_x, AVG(absolute_velocity_x) AS avg_vel FROM left_turn_objs GROUP BY start_ts, end_ts, obj_id) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, min_x, avg_vel FROM per_obj ORDER BY min_x ASC

nl: CTE: 变道时前车距离变化趋势
sql: WITH lanechange_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.type FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'LaneChange' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 AND d.x < 60), with_lag AS (SELECT *, LAG(x) OVER (PARTITION BY start_ts, obj_id ORDER BY ts) AS prev_x FROM lanechange_frames) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, ts, obj_id, x, prev_x, x - prev_x AS dist_change FROM with_lag WHERE prev_x IS NOT NULL ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: CTE: 找出先跟车太近后急刹的危险序列
sql: WITH close_follow AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'CloseFollow'), jerk_after AS (SELECT c.start_ts AS cf_start, c.end_ts AS cf_end, j.start_ts AS jerk_start FROM close_follow c JOIN range_tag j ON j.tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(j.param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake' AND j.start_ts >= c.start_ts AND j.start_ts <= c.end_ts) SELECT cf_start, cf_end, jerk_start, jerk_start - cf_start AS time_to_brake FROM jerk_after ORDER BY time_to_brake

nl: CTE: 统计每个切入片段中目标的类型和运动方向
sql: WITH cutin_objs AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.obj_id, d.type, AVG(d.x) AS avg_x, AVG(d.y) AS avg_y, AVG(d.heading) AS avg_heading FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Cutin' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 GROUP BY r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.obj_id, d.type) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, type, avg_x, avg_y, avg_heading FROM cutin_objs ORDER BY start_ts

nl: CTE: 路口右转时自车与行人/骑行者的最近距离
sql: WITH vru_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.type FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_RIGHTTURN' AND d.type IN ('pedestrian','cyclist') AND d.is_static = 0), per_clip AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, type, MIN(x) AS min_x, MIN(y) AS min_y FROM vru_frames GROUP BY start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, type) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, type, min_x, min_y FROM per_clip ORDER BY min_x ASC

nl: CTE: 黄灯过线时自车速度和红绿灯状态
sql: WITH yellow_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, e.traffic_light_status FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'CrossStopLineOnYellowLight') SELECT *, CASE WHEN speed > 30 THEN 'FAST' WHEN speed > 10 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'SLOW' END AS speed_level FROM yellow_frames ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: CTE: 找出多障碍物绕行避让的场景
sql: WITH avoidance_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.type, d.x, d.y FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'AVOIDANCE_MULTIOBSTACLEAROUNDEGO' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0), per_clip AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts, COUNT(DISTINCT obj_id) AS obstacle_count FROM avoidance_frames GROUP BY start_ts, end_ts) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obstacle_count FROM per_clip WHERE obstacle_count >= 2 ORDER BY obstacle_count DESC

nl: CTE: 切入后自车的制动反应——从切入开始到自车减速的延迟
sql: WITH cutin_brake AS (SELECT r.start_ts AS cutin_start, r.end_ts AS cutin_end, e.ts, e.speed, e.acc_magnitude FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Cutin'), brake_detected AS (SELECT cutin_start, cutin_end, ts AS brake_ts, speed FROM cutin_brake WHERE acc_magnitude > 2) SELECT cutin_start, cutin_end, MIN(brake_ts) AS first_brake_ts, MIN(brake_ts) - cutin_start * 1e9 AS reaction_delay_ns FROM brake_detected GROUP BY cutin_start, cutin_end ORDER BY reaction_delay_ns

nl: DR轨迹: 找出路口左转时自车和障碍物轨迹漂移值
sql: WITH left_turn AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_LEFTTURN'), frames AS (SELECT l.start_ts, l.end_ts, e.ts, e.ego_dr_trajectory, d.obj_id, d.obs_dr_trajectory, d.x, d.y FROM left_turn l JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN l.start_ts * 1e9 AND l.end_ts * 1e9 JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts = e.ts AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, ts, obj_id, x, y, ego_dr_trajectory, obs_dr_trajectory FROM frames ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: DR轨迹: 无保护左转——自车横向漂移大且对向来车在接近
sql: WITH left_turn AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_LEFTTURN'), frames AS (SELECT l.start_ts, l.end_ts, e.ts, e.ego_dr_trajectory, d.obj_id, d.obs_dr_trajectory, d.x, d.y, d.heading FROM left_turn l JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN l.start_ts * 1e9 AND l.end_ts * 1e9 JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts = e.ts AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0 AND d.type IN ('car','truck','bus','unknown_vehicle') AND d.absolute_velocity_x > 2), drift_check AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, ts, x, y, CASE WHEN ABS(json_extract(ego_dr_trajectory, '$.y[4]') - json_extract(ego_dr_trajectory, '$.y[0]')) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ego_lateral, CASE WHEN (json_extract(obs_dr_trajectory, '$.x[4]') - json_extract(obs_dr_trajectory, '$.x[0])) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS obs_approaching FROM frames) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, ts, x, y FROM drift_check WHERE ego_lateral = 1 AND obs_approaching = 1 ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: CTE: 切入博弈分析——自车是让行还是继续通过
sql: WITH cutin_clip AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts FROM range_tag r WHERE r.tag_name = 'Cutin'), with_speed AS (SELECT c.start_ts, c.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.start_ts ORDER BY e.ts) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.start_ts ORDER BY e.ts DESC) AS rn_last FROM cutin_clip c JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN c.start_ts * 1e9 AND c.end_ts * 1e9), agg AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts, MIN(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN speed END) AS first_speed, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN speed END) AS last_speed, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM with_speed GROUP BY start_ts, end_ts) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, first_speed, last_speed, min_speed, max_speed, CASE WHEN min_speed < 3 AND max_speed < 10 THEN 'ego_yielded_stop' WHEN first_speed - last_speed > 8 AND last_speed < 15 THEN 'ego_yielded_smooth' WHEN first_speed - last_speed > 3 AND last_speed > 5 THEN 'ego_proceeded_cautious' WHEN last_speed >= first_speed * 0.8 THEN 'ego_proceeded_clear' ELSE 'other' END AS behavior FROM agg ORDER BY start_ts

nl: CTE: 近距离碰撞——找出TTC最低的帧并标记严重程度
sql: WITH obj_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.absolute_velocity_x FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'LowTTC' AND d.is_static = 0 AND d.x > 0), with_ttc AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN absolute_velocity_x > 0 THEN x / absolute_velocity_x ELSE 999 END AS ttc FROM obj_frames) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, ts, obj_id, x, ttc, CASE WHEN ttc < 1 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN ttc < 2 THEN 'DANGER' WHEN ttc < 4 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'SAFE' END AS severity FROM with_ttc WHERE ttc < 10 ORDER BY ttc ASC

nl: CTE: 急刹时自车减速度逐帧变化并标注严重程度
sql: WITH brake_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, e.ts, e.speed, e.acc_magnitude FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'Jerk' AND json_extract(r.param, '$.sub_tag') = 'brake') SELECT start_ts, end_ts, ts, speed, acc_magnitude, CASE WHEN acc_magnitude > 6 THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN acc_magnitude > 3 THEN 'HARD' WHEN acc_magnitude > 1.5 THEN 'MODERATE' ELSE 'LIGHT' END AS brake_severity FROM brake_frames ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: 找出自车所在车道类型
sql: SELECT e.ts, dl.lane_type, dl.lane_turn_type, e.speed FROM ego e JOIN dynamic_lane dl ON dl.ts = e.ts AND dl.lane_id = e.ego_lane_id ORDER BY e.ts

nl: 找出自车当前道路的限速
sql: SELECT e.ts, dl.link_exp_speed_limit, e.speed FROM ego e JOIN dynamic_link dl ON dl.ts = e.ts AND dl.link_id = e.ego_link_id ORDER BY e.ts

nl: 找出自车超速的时刻
sql: SELECT e.ts, dl.link_exp_speed_limit, e.speed, e.speed - dl.link_exp_speed_limit AS excess FROM ego e JOIN dynamic_link dl ON dl.ts = e.ts AND dl.link_id = e.ego_link_id WHERE e.speed > dl.link_exp_speed_limit ORDER BY excess DESC

nl: 找出自车所在车道的边界信息
sql: SELECT e.ts, dl.lane_type, dl.left_boundary_id, dl.right_boundary_id, e.ego_to_left_boundary_dist, e.ego_to_right_boundary_dist FROM ego e JOIN dynamic_lane dl ON dl.ts = e.ts AND dl.lane_id = e.ego_lane_id ORDER BY e.ts

nl: CTE: 变道前后车道变化——变道前后的车道类型和转向类型
sql: WITH lc_clip AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'LaneChange'), with_lane AS (SELECT l.start_ts, l.end_ts, e.ts, e.ego_lane_id, dl.lane_type, dl.lane_turn_type FROM lc_clip l JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN l.start_ts * 1e9 AND l.end_ts * 1e9 JOIN dynamic_lane dl ON dl.ts = e.ts AND dl.lane_id = e.ego_lane_id) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, ts, ego_lane_id, lane_type, lane_turn_type FROM with_lane ORDER BY start_ts, ts

nl: 找出同时有跟车太近和切入的片段
sql: SELECT a.start_ts, a.end_ts FROM range_tag a JOIN range_tag b ON a.start_ts <= b.end_ts AND a.end_ts >= b.start_ts WHERE a.tag_name = 'CloseFollow' AND b.tag_name = 'Cutin' ORDER BY a.start_ts

nl: 找出路口场景中的所有标签分布
sql: SELECT tag_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name LIKE 'INTERSECTION%' OR tag_name LIKE 'Traffic%' OR tag_name LIKE 'RunRed%' OR tag_name LIKE 'CrossStop%' OR tag_name LIKE 'GreenLight%' GROUP BY tag_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

nl: 找出转向灯状态和变道事件的对应关系
sql: SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, r.tag_name, e.ts, e.indicator_status, e.steering_angle FROM range_tag r JOIN ego e ON e.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name IN ('LaneChange', 'SolidLaneChange') ORDER BY r.start_ts, e.ts

nl: CTE: 找出横向穿越车道的行人并计算穿越速度
sql: WITH cross_frames AS (SELECT r.start_ts, r.end_ts, d.ts, d.obj_id, d.x, d.y, d.absolute_velocity_y FROM range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON d.ts BETWEEN r.start_ts * 1e9 AND r.end_ts * 1e9 WHERE r.tag_name = 'CrossVRUV1' AND d.type = 'pedestrian'), per_obj AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, MIN(y) AS min_y, MAX(y) AS max_y, MAX(y) - MIN(y) AS y_range, AVG(ABS(absolute_velocity_y)) AS avg_lateral_speed FROM cross_frames GROUP BY start_ts, end_ts, obj_id) SELECT start_ts, end_ts, obj_id, y_range, avg_lateral_speed FROM per_obj WHERE y_range > 2 ORDER BY avg_lateral_speed DESC

nl: CTE: 找出所有标签片段并按时间排序查看场景序列
sql: WITH all_tags AS (SELECT start_ts, end_ts, tag_name, json_extract(param, '$.sub_tag') AS sub_tag FROM range_tag ORDER BY start_ts), overlaps AS (SELECT a.start_ts, a.end_ts, a.tag_name AS tag_a, b.tag_name AS tag_b FROM all_tags a JOIN all_tags b ON a.start_ts < b.end_ts AND a.end_ts > b.start_ts AND a.tag_name < b.tag_name) SELECT tag_a, tag_b, COUNT(*) AS co_occurrence FROM overlaps GROUP BY tag_a, tag_b ORDER BY co_occurrence DESC

nl: 找出路口且有红绿灯的场景
sql: SELECT r1.start_ts, r1.end_ts, r1.tag_name AS intersection_tag, r2.tag_name AS light_tag FROM range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ON r1.start_ts <= r2.end_ts AND r1.end_ts >= r2.start_ts WHERE (r1.tag_name LIKE 'INTERSECTION%' OR r1.tag_name IN ('Intersection','TrafficIntersection')) AND r2.tag_name IN ('TrafficLightAbnormal','RunRedLight','CrossStopLineOnYellowLight','GreenLightNotProceeding','YellowLightStop','STOPANDGO_FIRSTCARSTOPATREDLIGHT','STOPANDGO_FIRSTCARSTARTATGREENLIGHT') ORDER BY r1.start_ts

nl: 找出路口且为绿灯的场景
sql: SELECT r1.start_ts, r1.end_ts, r1.tag_name AS intersection_tag, r2.tag_name AS light_tag FROM range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ON r1.start_ts <= r2.end_ts AND r1.end_ts >= r2.start_ts WHERE (r1.tag_name LIKE 'INTERSECTION%' OR r1.tag_name IN ('Intersection','TrafficIntersection')) AND r2.tag_name IN ('STOPANDGO_FIRSTCARSTARTATGREENLIGHT','GreenLightNotProceeding','STOPANDGO_TRAFFICLIGHTGREENFLASHGO') ORDER BY r1.start_ts

nl: 找出路口且为红灯的场景
sql: SELECT r1.start_ts, r1.end_ts, r1.tag_name AS intersection_tag, r2.tag_name AS light_tag FROM range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ON r1.start_ts <= r2.end_ts AND r1.end_ts >= r2.start_ts WHERE (r1.tag_name LIKE 'INTERSECTION%' OR r1.tag_name IN ('Intersection','TrafficIntersection')) AND r2.tag_name IN ('STOPANDGO_FIRSTCARSTOPATREDLIGHT','RunRedLight','STOPANDGO_TRAFFICLIGHTREDWAIT','STOPANDGO_TRAFFICLIGHTREDSTART') ORDER BY r1.start_ts
